privacy.title: Privacy Policy

overview.title: Overview
overview.text: Seal is a privacy-focused messaging app built on the Nostr protocol. We are committed to protecting your privacy and do not collect, store, or share any personal data.

encryption.title: End-to-End Encryption
encryption.text: All messages in Seal are end-to-end encrypted using NIP-44 encryption.
encryption.item1: Only you and your recipient can read your messages
encryption.item2: Your private key never leaves your device
encryption.item3: Not even relay operators can decrypt your messages

relays.title: Nostr Relays
relays.text: Seal uses the decentralized Nostr network to deliver messages.
relays.item1: Messages are routed through public Nostr relays
relays.item2: Relays only see encrypted data, not message content
relays.item3: You can choose which relays to use or run your own

push.title: Push Notifications
push.text: Push notifications are optional and use ntfy.sh for delivery.
push.item1: Push is opt-in and can be disabled anytime
push.item2: The push server only knows your public key
push.item3: You can self-host both the push server and ntfy instance

localStorage.title: Local Data Storage
localStorage.text: All your data is stored locally on your device.
localStorage.item1: Messages, contacts, and keys are stored in your browser/app
localStorage.item2: No data is uploaded to our servers
localStorage.item3: Local storage must be encrypted with a password

deletion.title: Data Deletion
deletion.text: You have full control over your data. You can delete all local data at any time in Settings. Additionally, you can send a NIP-62 vanish request to ask relays to delete your data from their servers.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: If you have questions about this privacy policy, please open an issue on

privacy.securityLimits: Limitations: this NIP-44/17 implementation does not provide forward secrecy. A stolen long-term private key can expose recorded messages. Relays can observe connection metadata; deletion requests cannot reliably remove third-party copies.
